r21_text_to_sql.explicacion: La consulta devuelve el proveedor nacional con stock que ofrece el producto PEC-01-0001 al precio total más barato, sumando precio estimado y envío.

intentos.sql: SELECT suppliers.name AS proveedor, (offers.estimated_brl_cents + offers.shipping_brl_cents)/100.0 AS precio_real FROM offers JOIN suppliers ON offers.supplier_id = suppliers.id JOIN parts ON offers.part_id = parts.id WHERE parts.sku = 'PEC-01-0001' AND suppliers.domestic = 1 AND offers.stock_qty > 0 ORDER BY (offers.estimated_brl_cents + offers.shipping_brl_cents) ASC LIMIT 1
